entry.title: Emergency Warning - Bushfire - Springfield, Ipswich Region
entry.summary: An Emergency Warning has been issued for a fast-moving bushfire in the Springfield area. Residents should leave immediately if safe to do so.

entry.title: Watch and Act - Flood - Bremer River, Ipswich
entry.summary: A Watch and Act alert has been issued for rising water levels on the Bremer River. Residents in low-lying areas should prepare to evacuate.

entry.title: Advice - Severe Weather - Southeast Queensland
entry.summary: Severe thunderstorms are forecast for Southeast Queensland this afternoon. Damaging winds and heavy rainfall expected.
